name: FarObj
source: analysis/s4/farobj_callers.log — Level-0 farobj callers probe, S4 2026-11-12
notes: Central game object instance record. Stored in a global slot table at R05_400C:0x34 (4 bytes/entry = far pointer per slot). Also referenced from scan list at 0x54AF:0x1734 (16 entries for active-object fast scan). farptr_table_get(slot_index) loads ES:DI = pointer to this struct. Struct is at least 210B; actual size unknown. Many fields confirmed by farobj_entity_attr_setup (initialiser) + farptr_table_accum_fields (3D pos add).

fields.name: angle_pitch
fields.comment: pitch angle (14-bit signed, fold via stub_to_24988)

fields.name: type_flags
fields.comment: type flags (AND 0x20 OR 5 pattern; bit 6 = range visibility)

fields.name: entity_class_hi
fields.comment: high byte of entity class word (usually 0 or sub-class)

fields.name: attr_b
fields.comment: scaled attribute B (from type descriptor +0xC, shifted by DS:19B7)

fields.name: frame_timer
fields.comment: frame counter (mod 8 by scan_74_timer_c for animation step)

fields.name: state_flags
fields.comment: state flags: bit 0x0040=has_ext_slot; bit 0x8000=scan_gate_set; bits 0xF1FF=timer state

fields.name: slot_flags
fields.comment: slot flags: bits 0–5 used; bits 6+7 cleared by sub_49A5B

fields.name: type_base
fields.comment: base type data (farobj_field_set writes here for type 1 & 3)

fields.comment: slot active/occupied flag: bit 0 = active (checked by scan_74 functions)

fields.name: timer_active

name: FarObjTypeDesc
notes: Per-entity-class type descriptor. The global table at 0x7B0E:0x3052 holds far pointers (4B each) to these records, indexed by FarObj.object_kind*4. farobj_type_field_get reads bytes [0] and [1] to return a 1/2/3 subtype code. farobj_entity_attr_setup reads offsets 0x0C/0x0E/0x10 as scaled entity attributes.

fields.comment: 0 or 1 = simple; >1 = complex (has subtype in byte 1)

fields.name: subtype

fields.name: scale_attr_b

fields.name: scale_attr_c

name: EntityAccumEntry
notes: Per-motion-command entry for the entity sweep table. farobj_entity_accum_sweep scans up to 39+1 entries (index 0..0x27), advancing by 14B per entry. Entry [+6] is a countdown timer (decremented each sweep; when 0, entry is idle). The BX/CX/DX words drive farptr_table_accum_fields (position delta) and farptr_table_offset_apply (angle delta).

fields.name: countdown
fields.comment: timer countdown; decremented by 1 each sweep (at +1 to get 0-based next)

name: EntitySlotRecord
source: docs/architecture/entity.md; farobj_slot_update_driver; RADAR_DETECTION_COMPLETE.md; IR_LOCK_ANALYSIS.md; TARGET_SYSTEM_FINDINGS.md; BUILDING_TYPE_INVESTIGATION.md
notes: Active entity slot record. 16 slots at segment 0x54AF, offset 0x386F. Updated 3-pass every frame by farobj_slot_update_driver. Contains per-frame processing state, update flags, and links to farobj instances. Radar system uses fields +0x08/0x0A (distance), +0x74/+0x79 (flags), +0x8E (azimuth), +0x92 (range), +0x96/98/9A (position) for detection and tracking. IR lock system uses field +0xAE (heat_signature) for AIM-9 seeker targeting. Target system uses fields +0x76 (unknown_flags_76), +0xAE (heat_signature),  +0xB3-0xBF (target tracking fields, 13 bytes), +0xCA (damage_status_flags). AI system uses fields +0xB3-0xBF for target priority evaluation (ai_target_priority_evaluator).
